_comment: Nemotron-H with LatentMoE (Nemotron-3 Super): the nemotron-h declarations (see configs/nemotron-h/arch.json — `backbone.*` root, per-kind mixer renames onto `mixer`, `layer_norm_epsilon`), plus the latent expert path: `moe.fc1_latent_proj` [hidden → moe_latent_size] feeds the routed experts and `moe.fc2_latent_proj` [moe_latent_size → hidden] projects their weighted sum back.
